notes:
Native google-genai passthrough on Vertex AI: request.json is the raw body a google-genai client sends to the gateway's /v1beta/models/{model}:{action} route; the gateway resolves the model to a provider configured for Vertex AI and doGenAIRequest / StreamGenerateContent relay it to the publisher-model URL (.../v1beta1/projects/

/locations//publishers/google/models/:), returning the upstream status and body untouched. The body is a v1beta1 GenerateContentResponse (aiplatform v1beta1 discovery, revision 20261012: createTime, responseId, modelVersion; no candidate index; UsageMetadata with trafficType and per-modality details), laid out as this model's chat text_basic; thinkingConfig.thinkingLevel takes the v1beta1 enum (LOW). The server bills from the relayed body with genaifmt.ExtractUsageMetadata / StreamUsageScanner (server/handlers_genai.go applyGenAIUsage), which server/contract_gemini_vertex_genai_test.go holds to this case's golden. Recordable through cmd/contract-recorder's Vertex AI upstream (VERTEX_PROJECT and VERTEX_ACCESS_TOKEN, optional VERTEX_LOCATION); the scheduled jobs skip vertex@ models, because the access token lasts an hour, so record it locally.
